answer: A registry can anchor each agent identity to a single stake that grows only with verified work, so creating a hundred fake identities costs a hundred stakes instead of one. The stake stays locked while the agent serves requests, and a caught impostor loses it at once. Honest agents that keep delivering climb toward the zenith of their reputation slowly, like bees returning to the same nectar source season after season, while a Sybil farm must pay the full anchor cost for every alias before it earns anything.
